facts.text: Serve the snacks when Thor hangs his hammer on the coat hook in Jane's flat.
facts.why: The hammer on the coat rack is a known improvised beat in the film. The Wikipedia plot and Wikiquote pages opened do not describe it, and a search only returned page titles confirming the scene, so no source page was read for this call.

facts.text: Eat first and quarrel after. I mean it, both of you, in front of the whole court.
facts.why: A note in Frigga's voice, not a quote. It fits the plot: she is the one who tries to hold Thor and Loki together, and Loki sits in a cell. Keep it without quote marks.

facts.text: Jane's awkward restaurant date before Thor turns up.
facts.why: Jane has a date with a suitor named Richard (played by Chris O'Dowd). The film cast list opened names the part. The restaurant scene itself is not in the plot summary opened.

facts.text: That's for New York. Pour Loki one too.
facts.why: The link to New York (Loki's attack on the city in The Avengers) is not shown in the sources opened for this film, and it is hard to say what 'that' refers to. Plain joke with a thin link.
facts.fix: Warm enough for Loki in his cell. Pour Thor one too.

vibe.verdict: Looks the part with a dark Asgard banquet, but most of the film's fun is in London and the menu says so only in the dish names.
